input.summary: Add annual frequency cap and 15 days' prior written notice to the Paragraph 9 review/audit right
input.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 9 gives any Party an unlimited, unannounced right to review or audit our books, which is our walk-away position. We have added the fallback limits — no more than once in any calendar year and 15 days' prior written notice — and left the existing cost allocation in 9.8 (requesting Party bears the audited Party's compliance costs) and the F&ASC procedure in 9.9 untouched.

ops.text: Any right of review or audit pursuant to this Paragraph 9 shall be exercisable in respect of any Party no more than once in any calendar year, and only upon not less than fifteen (15) days' prior written notice to that Party.
